title: Abduce
summary: ABDU'CE, verb transitive [Latin adduco, to lead away, of ab and duco, to lead. See Duke.] To draw from; to withdraw, or draw to a different part; used chiefly in anatomy.

inlines.v: ABDU'CE, verb transitive [Latin adduco, to lead away, of ab and duco, to lead. See Duke.] To draw from; to withdraw, or draw to a different part; used chiefly in anatomy.
